name: m1-fix-cli
coordination:
- `m1-fix-lifecycle` owns `src/shepherd/**`, `src/run/**`, `src/stream/**`, `src/registry/**`, `src/quota/**` and
  `src/commands/wait.ts`. It will make the shepherd read `mode.promptFile`, and it changes `FinishedItem`
  (nullable `attempt` and `summary`, new `endState` and `reason`). Do not use `FinishedItem` outside `wait.ts`.
- `m1-fix-fence` owns `src/profile/**`, `src/config/**`, `src/report/**`, `src/brief/**` and changes the probe
  report schema to steps `{n, command, exit_code, output}`. Preflight already uses that shape in its own schema;
  keep it.
